findings: NNDC Sigma public basic search exposes neutron/proton reaction retrieval, including (n,p) as a search class.
ENSDF adopted 71Ge evaluation explicitly lists 2022Ba21/2022Ba17 as 71Ge(nu,e) from 51Cr decay in BEST.
ENSDF also lists 71Ga(3He,t) and 71Ga(p,n) / 71Ga(p,ng) references relevant to excited-state strength constraints.
A ready-made NNDC numeric table for 71Ga(nu,e) cross sections was not found on the public Sigma endpoint used here.
